==Background==
"'''Flyway'''" is an original soft rock, pop, pop rock, RnB, rock song by halyosy. It was commissioned for the unit {{IW|ProjectSekai|Leo/need}} from the game ''{{IW|ProjectSekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}''.

This song has entered the ''[[Hall of Fame]]'' and exceeded over 3 million YouTube views.

==Other media appearances==
===Discography===
This song is featured on the single ''Flyway''.

This song is also featured on the compilation album ''[[初音ミク「マジカルミライ 2025」OFFICIAL ALBUM (Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2025" OFFICIAL ALBUM)|Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2025" OFFICIAL ALBUM]]''.

===Concerts===
This song was featured in the [[Hatsune Miku Magical Mirai 2025|Magical Mirai 2025]] concert.

===Video games===
This song is featured in the game ''{{IW|projectsekai|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE!|Project SEKAI COLORFUL STAGE! feat. Hatsune Miku}}'' (Virtual Singer version by Kagamine Len and KAITO; SEKAI version by Leo/need and Kagamine Len).

==Trivia==
* halyosy took inspiration from a swan to write the lyrics of "Flyway": the ecology and the take-flight figure of migatory birds are superimposed on Leo/need to create a base image for the production of the song.<ref>[https://x.com/halyosy/status/1619992738774286336 halyosy's Tweet]</ref>
